content.text: No exclusivity language exists; § 14.16 affirmatively preserves each party's freedom to contract with others.

input.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no exclusivity, "sole supplier" or all-requirements obligation on Customer. Searches for "exclusive", "sole", "requirements from" and "shall not procure" return only unrelated uses (warranty exclusivity in § 5.2, nonexclusive licences in §§ 5.4/12.1, tax-exclusive charges in § 4.3, and "sole discretion" references). § 4.1 sets charges by Order Form/Service Option Attachment without any minimum-purchase or single-source commitment. Affirmatively, § 14.16 (Freedom of Action) states each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others, which preserves our freedom to buy the same services from other suppliers and meets the preferred position. § 14.11 (No Resale) restricts resale of the Services only and is not an exclusive-dealing covenant, so it is not flagged under this rule.
